text:
Predicates:
Ranked(x) ::: x is ranked highly by the Women's Tennis Association.
Active(x) ::: x is among the most active players in major tennis.
LostToIga(x) ::: x lost to Iga Świątek.
LostToRafael(x) ::: x lost to Rafael Nadal.
Female(x) ::: x is a female tennis player at Roland Garros 2022.
Male(x) ::: x is a male tennis player at Roland Garros 2022.
Premises:
∀x (Ranked(x) → Active(x)) ::: If a player is ranked highly by the Women's Tennis Association, then they are among the most active players in major tennis.
∀x (LostToIga(x) → Ranked(x)) ::: Everyone who lost to Iga Świątek is ranked highly by the Women's Tennis Association.
∀x (Female(x) → LostToIga(x)) ::: All female tennis players at Roland Garros 2022 lost to Iga Świątek.
Female(coco) ⊕ Male(coco) ::: Either female tennis players at Roland Garros 2022 or male tennis players at Roland Garros 2022.
∀x (Male(x) → LostToRafael(x)) ::: All male tennis players at Roland Garros 2022 lost to Rafael Nadal.
(Ranked(coco) ∨ LostToRafael(coco)) → ¬Male(coco) ::: If Coco Gauff is a player who is ranked highly by the Women's Tennis Association or a player who lost to Rafael Nadal, then Coco Gauff is not a male tennis player at Roland Garros 2022.
Conclusion:
LostToRafael(coco) ::: Coco Gauff has lost to Rafael Nadal.
